text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haaah-ah... Oh, Trainer-san, is that you?
choice_data_list: What's with the sigh? What's wrong?
What's with the sigh? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, it's just that today's big 
cleaning day at the dorms~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I was going to pass on it, but our 
dorm leader, Hishi Ama-san, caught me."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, after a desperate chase, I managed 
to hide in a locker and wait it out, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...When I tried to get out, it wouldn't 
open. The locker door, that is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I got snagged in a weird spot. 
Ugh, it was so cramped and dark, total 
nightmare...
